headline: Rs 42.6 lakh from 5 clients will lock within 10 days; JC-1240 wasted 18% last night.

items.text: Sunrise Pharma locks on Sunday 22-Nov (Rs 14.2 lakh). Cheque promised for 21-Nov.
Royal Spices promised 25-Nov, two days after its lock date. Call today.
JC-1240 night shift wastage 18.0% (limit 15%): magenta plate damaged twice.
PP Silver 200 mm short by 700 m for JC-1310 and JC-1315. Purchase request drafted.
Pay Shree Ganesh Films Rs 1,86,400 by 23-Nov (MSME).
Month so far: revenue Rs 38.6 lakh (64% of target), profit Rs 7.7 lakh, OEE 55%.
